text: Thanks Sam, and let's dive into some sporting action from around the globe. <cite index='34-3'>Celtic netted a dramatic double to sink Hearts and clinch their record-extending Scottish Premiership</cite>. Those Bhoys know how to put on a show when it matters!

speaker: alice
text: Love a good comeback story! And closer to our neck of the woods, <cite index='34-3'>Sydney FC edged past Newcastle Jets on penalties to reach the A-League Grand Final</cite>. Nothing beats the drama of a penalty shootout to sort out who's got the bigger ticker.

speaker: charlie
text: Too right! And for our golf fans, the PGA Championship is wrapping up at Aronimink this weekend with some absolute legends in the mix. Sometimes sport just gives you those moments that remind you why we love it so much.
